title: Vision of the Absolute
summary: Reforged spear that can Blind and deals extra damage to certain many-eyed enemies.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Piercing one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength. Simple, versatile, thrown, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Absolute Night: A qualifying melee hit forces a fixed DC 11 Dexterity save or Blinds for 2 turns. Against certain many-eyed creatures, such as spiders and spectators, melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 Piercing. Neither effect applies when thrown. The combat log may misattribute the save or describe it as spell DC.
fields.Blinded: Disadvantage on attacks, advantage to attackers, most attack and spell ranges capped at 10 ft, and no Opportunity Attacks. Throw range is unaffected.
fields.Rush Attack: Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Charge up to 30 ft and strike the first non-allied creature or object for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Piercing. Strength save against weapon-action DC prevents Off Balance for 2 turns. Off Balance gives disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and advantage to attackers. Damage or Help ends it.
fields.Crafting: Combine Edowin’s broken shaft with the head from the owlbear mother. Grants A New Vision to Guild Artisan party members.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
